subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Anupama was a very __industrious__ child and submitted all her assignments on time.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Lazy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"industrious"** means hardworking, diligent, and constantly engaged in productive work. (परिश्रमी)

 
 
• **Example: **She is an industrious student who spends hours studying and completing her assignments.
 
 
 
• **"Lazy"** refers to someone who is unwilling to work or use energy, or who avoids effort. (आलसी)
 
 
• **Example: **He was too lazy to get out of bed and do his chores.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"industrious"** is **"lazy"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Lazy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Laborious **(कष्टसाध्य): Requiring considerable effort and hard work.

 
 
• **Example: **Writing a book is a laborious task that demands patience and dedication.
 
 
 
• **Industrial **(औद्योगिक): Relating to industry, manufacturing, or production.
 
 
• **Example: **The city is known for its industrial growth and innovation.
 
 
 
• **Intense **(तीव्र): Of extreme force, degree, or strength.
 
 
• **Example: **His intense focus helped him win the competition.
